Per poter inquadrare il problema prova a fornire queste informazioni:

  1. Versione di Thunderbird
  2. Versione del sistema operativo
  3. Provider delle caselle email (Gmail, Libero, Hotmail, etc.)
  4. Tipologia di account (POP3, IMAP)
  5. Estensioni installate
  6. Messaggi di errore che vengono visualizzati durante l'utilizzo di Thunderbird
  7. Software di sicurezza eventualmente presenti (Antivirus e simili)
  8. Screenshot del problema

content: I am not aware of a feature to search for folders. My suggestion is to use the folderpane on the left side of your screen and expand all folders. Post a screenshot and we may be able to assist in suggesting where to look.

You seem to be using capital letters - maybe you had caps lock enabled. As a heads up, using Capital letters generally means you are shouting which I'm sure you did not intend.

It's likely your Anti-Virus is causing the problem.

This certificate issue has been recently mentioned by various people and so far all those cases are due to the Anti-Virus they use. Most common were reported by those using Avast and AVG.
